videos.headline: Miller races 89 yards for Memphis TD
videos.description: Anthony Miller runs 89 yards for a Tigers touchdown on the first play from scrimmage in the first quarter.

videos.headline: Pollard races 100 yards for Memphis TD
videos.description: Memphis' Tony Pollard returns the kickoff 100 yards for a Tigers touchdown to make it 63-6 in the third quarter.

videos.headline: Henderson scampers in for Memphis TD
videos.description: Darrell Henderson runs 4 yards for a Tigers touchdown to increase their lead to 14-0 in the first quarter.

videos.headline: A pick-six for Cook, Memphis
videos.description: East Carolina's Gardner Minshew's pass is intercepted by Jonathan Cook who returns it 32 yards for a touchdown to make it 21-0 in the first quarter.

videos.headline: Ferguson to Mayhue TD extends the lead for Memphis
videos.description: Riley Ferguson hits Phil Mayhue for a 46-yard touchdown pass to make it 28-0 in the first quarter.

videos.headline: Taylor's big run for Memphis TD
videos.description: Patrick Taylor Jr. runs for a 41-yard touchdown to make it 42-0 for the Tigers in the second quarter.

videos.headline: Minshew to Williams TD put East Carolina on the board
videos.description: Gardner Minshew hits Jimmy Williams for a 33-yard touchdown pass to get East Carolina on the scoreboard.

videos.headline: Taylor dashes 60 yards for Memphis TD
videos.description: Patrick Taylor Jr.'s second rushing touchdown of the game makes it 70-13 in the fourth quarter.

videos.headline: Perry with INT for Memphis
videos.description: Memphis' Josh Perry intercepts East Carolina's Gardner Minshew to set up the Tigers.

videos.headline: Dorceus high steps in  for Memphis TD
videos.description: Doroland  Dorceus scores from 19-yards out to increase the Tigers' lead to 35-0 in the second quarter.

videos.headline: Thomas with INT for Memphis
videos.description: Memphis' La'Andre Thomas intercepts Gardner Minshew deep in Memphis territory to stop the East Carolina drive.

videos.headline: Henderson's second TD run continues Memphis' rout
videos.description: Darrell Henderson scores from 14 yards out to increase the margin to 49-0 in the second quarter.

videos.headline: Coxie's 61-yard TD continues Memphis route
videos.description: Memphis' Damonte Coxie scores on a 61-yard pass play to make it 56-0 in the third quarter.

videos.headline: Baggett grabs TD for East Carolina
videos.description: East Carolina's Stephen Baggett makes the catch for a 5-yard touchdown reception in the third quarter.
